headline: You can’t ignore Google Zero anymore
summary: Google's long-standing deal with websites, exchanging data for traffic, is reportedly dead. Google Zero, where users find answers directly on Google, is reducing referral traffic to content creators. This shift is significantly impacting websites and publishers.

headline: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
summary: Anthropic launched its new AI model, Claude Opus 5, following recent industry events. The company claims Opus 5's capabilities are nearly on par with Claude Fable 5 in many areas. This release aims to compete in the rapidly evolving AI landscape.

headline: Meta is making its AI chatbot more like an assistant
summary: Meta is enhancing its AI chatbot with new productivity features to rival competitors. The updated Meta AI can integrate with calendars for event planning and daily briefings. It also offers guided, in-depth research capabilities.

headline: Tesla’s car door defect could lead to tougher rules for everyone
summary: Tesla's electronic door handles have been linked to multiple fatalities. The NHTSA isn't launching a defect investigation but sees this as a broader industry issue. This could result in stricter safety regulations for all car manufacturers.

headline: King of the Hill’s Pamela Adlon Reveals Her Favorite Bobby Hill Episodes
summary: Pamela Adlon, voice of Bobby Hill, discussed the upcoming King of the Hill Hulu revival. She shared insights into finding 21-year-old Bobby's voice for the new series. Adlon expressed her desire to continue playing Bobby Hill indefinitely.

headline: The 4K-Ready MSI Codex Z2 GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC Drops to $1,699 After a $600 Discount
summary: The MSI Codex Z2 gaming PC with an RTX 5070 Ti GPU is now $1,699. This represents a significant $600 discount off its original price. The deal makes a 4K-ready gaming PC more accessible.

headline: Save $1,500 Off an Alienware Area-51 Ryzen X3D Gaming PC With RTX 5090 GPU and 64GB of RAM
summary: An Alienware Area-51 gaming PC with an RTX 5090 and 64GB RAM is available with a $1,500 discount. Despite the discount, it remains an expensive, high-end machine. This deal offers a competitive price for an extremely powerful gaming setup.

headline: The $1,800 Power Lift Recliner and Massage Chair Drops to $350 at Wayfair After a Massive 80% Discount
summary: A power lift recliner and massage chair, originally $1,800, is now on sale for $350. Wayfair is offering a massive 80% discount on this item. This deal provides significant savings on a high-comfort chair.

headline: Southport killer Axel Rudakubana appears to be manipulating the system, families' lawyer says
summary: Axel Rudakubana, convicted in Southport, has been moved to a secure psychiatric hospital. A lawyer for the victims' families suggests he may be manipulating the justice system. The transfer raises questions about the handling of the case.

headline: 'Extremely significant' bomb in car intercepted on way to NI, Irish police say
summary: Irish police (Gardaí) intercepted a highly significant car bomb en route to Northern Ireland. A woman in her 20s has been charged in connection with the incident. She is scheduled to appear in court on Friday evening.

headline: Officers hurt as police boat hits Westminster Bridge
summary: A police boat crashed into Westminster Bridge, injuring several officers. A number of armed officers reportedly entered the River Thames. All involved officers were successfully recovered after the collision.

headline: Andy Burnham's first week pledges - how much do they add up to?
summary: BBC Verify analyzed Andy Burnham's new spending commitments made in his first week. The analysis assessed the total cost of his pledges. It also investigated how these commitments would be funded.
